doc.title: Eddie Miller and Pete Fountain Interview, 1970-01-09

title: Caller praises Pete's tone
summary: An elderly New Orleans trumpeter calls to compliment Pete's tone; Pete says he strives for tone over technique.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
